# Mastermind Academy

> Mastermind Academy is a coaching institute in Nehru Nagar, Belagavi, Karnataka, offering Spoken English classes (online and offline), Interview Mastery with Personality Development, Class 6 to 10 school tuition for CBSE, ICSE, KVS and State Board, and academic coaching for B.E, BCA and Diploma students.

Tagline: Learn · Practice · Excel (Education Hub for a Brighter Future)
Location: Nehru Nagar, Belagavi, Karnataka 590010
Areas Served: Nehru Nagar, Belagavi and nearby areas
Phone / WhatsApp: 90194 16236, 81239 50627
Lecturers: Laxmi (B.E), Pooja (B.E)
